operations.description: Invite a user (by id or login) to a folder; an unknown login becomes a pending invite (POST /2.0/collaborations).
Remove a collaboration; collaborators may remove their own (DELETE /2.0/collaborations/{collaboration_id}).
List a folder's collaborations, including pending invites, with marker paging (GET /2.0/folders/{folder_id}/collaborations).
Comment on a file or reply to a comment (POST /2.0/comments).
List a file's comments, oldest first (GET /2.0/files/{file_id}/comments).
Read the caller's user event stream (all or changes) from a stream position (GET /2.0/events).
Copy a file (optionally a specific version) into a folder (POST /2.0/files/{file_id}/copy).
Move a file to the trash (DELETE /2.0/files/{file_id}).
Download the current or a previous version; the route answers with the bytes (GET /2.0/files/{file_id}/content).
Get a file (GET /2.0/files/{file_id}).
List a file's previous versions, newest first (GET /2.0/files/{file_id}/versions).
Restore a trashed file, optionally renamed or into another folder (POST /2.0/files/{file_id}).
Rename, describe, tag or move a file, honouring If-Match (PUT /2.0/files/{file_id}).
Upload a new UTF-8 text file with multipart attributes + file parts (POST /api/2.0/files/content).
Upload a new version of a file, honouring If-Match (POST /api/2.0/files/{file_id}/content).
Copy a folder and its active contents (POST /2.0/folders/{folder_id}/copy).
Create a folder (POST /2.0/folders).
Move a folder (recursive=true for non-empty folders) to the trash (DELETE /2.0/folders/{folder_id}).
Get a folder with the first page of its items; folder_id 0 is the caller's All Files root (GET /2.0/folders/{folder_id}).
List a folder's items with offset or marker paging; folder_id trash lists the caller's trash (GET /2.0/folders/{folder_id}/items).
Rename, describe, tag or move a folder, honouring If-Match (PUT /2.0/folders/{folder_id}).
Search visible items by name, description, file content, comments and tags with AND/OR/NOT and filters (GET /2.0/search).
Get the calling user (GET /2.0/users/me).

connections.title: Box REST client (test process)
connections.instructions: Point the client's API and upload base URLs at BOX_API_BASE_URL (paths /2.0/... and /api/2.0/...) and send BOX_DEVELOPER_TOKEN as the Bearer token. Test processes only.
